第二轮第三轮内测玩家前来短评。本游戏是第一人称神庙探险游戏，晕3D者慎入。游戏节奏感和动作感非常强。 需要一提的是，本游戏的最大特点“幻影”其实在游戏过程中影响不是很大，这仍然是一个本质单机游戏。你可以把幻影认为是本游戏的锦上添花，但是不要奔着幻影机制买这游戏，那样子你是会失望的。 =============2022.10.20 冒险更新之后============= PA又双叒叕经历了一轮游戏机制大更新，这波更新挺好的，老实讲之前那个大版本游戏寿命实在是太短。 现在分为两种模式：冒险模式是提升段位，生命值相对固定；而经典模式则是之前大版本的游戏模式，生命值靠吸魂增长。 在新版本下新人获得鞭子和获取圣物都变得更加容易，同时也为之后的内容更新留好了接口。要按照之前版本的模式，某些地牢想要过关只能让前人死多一点靠吸魂续命。 该版本鞭子的诅咒不能被去除，一些老玩家可能不高兴，但在我看来这是一项积极的改动。原来那个版本所有鞭子祝福完毕后就直接开始养老了，挑战性全无。 [i]恭喜骑士鞭超越虚空鞭一跃成为最强鞭！[/i]

==================== The Short: If you enjoy fast paced platforming and feeling like being as close as you can to one of our favorite childhood lost-ark raider, than you're in the right place. I've beaten the highest tier on this game about three times and I have every intention to complete that collection of idols to accompany my hard-earned cardboard box. ==================== The Long: -If I recall correctly, you're playing a prisoner trapped in a temple alongside a forgotten god of the Abyss and, for better or worse, both of your escape is tied to your ability to gather "relics" and restore the forgotten god's power. That's about as much as you get for the story; which is refreshingly concise. -After completing the tutorial and acquiring baby's first whip, you'll soon find yourself delving into the dungeon, stumbling about as you get sliced, impaled, crushed, bludgeoned, cratered, incinerated, suffocated, and even eaten. Given time, it all starts coming together as you then begin recognize the patterns various traps have and the proper timing to navigate your respective hellscape. Sometimes that happens deftly, other times it's by the skin of your teeth. -Currently there are three tiers/stages of which you can rush through, each with five levels a piece, and it seems there is the framework for even more content later on. The Good: -I've found the game to be surprisingly fluid. Takes a few runs to get a feel for how much reach your whip actually has and what maneuvers you can get away with, but it doesn't take long to get the hang of it. You can take fall damage, but there is a mechanic that let's you negate that damage and it's fairly forgiving. Before you know it, you'll be trapeze-ing about like a circus acrobat. -Even if you fall down into a pit, you're respawned back at the beginning of the room you were in. You lose some of your health in the process, but at least it's not a run-ending penalty. -The traps all have tells to them, making itself known and giving you but a brief moment to react before you suffer the consequences. Being able to dodge out of the way, or avoid activating the trap entirely, is going to depend almost entirely on you as the player. Alternatively, a wayward soul can also activate some traps or deactivate others briefly by using their trusty whip on said traps. -The addition of guardians, the closest thing to an enemy you'll have in this game, are unkillable and constantly tailing you and ensure that you cannot take the entire game at a slow and steady pace. It gives the game a sense of urgency that otherwise would be lacking and I believe that Phantom Abyss is all the better for it. The "Bad": -The rooms you run through have a "prefabricated" feel to them, and the randomness comes into play when the game decides what order its going to lay out those rooms for your level. If any of you have ever played "Gunfire Reborn" you'll probably know exactly the feeling I'm describing. You learn quickly that the rooms themselves don't change so much as the way/order the game lays out these rooms from run to run. Treasure chests seem to be in the same place every time, every ledge remains in its proper place, and even the same holes in the floors are all still crying out for maintenance. When you encounter a room enough times, you can quickly pick up how to navigate these all-too-familiar setups. -Elevation beats almost all the traps you invariably encounter. Don't get me wrong, the existing traps are all fantastic! However, as the player you can pick up two very specific powers that not only make the character incredibly mobile, which has its merits, but can trivialize entire networks of traps in the later stages of the game because there's little to no risk in taking to the skies. I would like to think of myself as a decent game, but I can largely attribute the success I've achieved in the game thus far to the combination of those two powers specifically. -Trap variety is somewhat low, but the game compensates well for this currently by making up for their variety with quantity and we can only expect so much given the game (at the time of me writing this review) only just came out in Early Access. Still, I hope one day I can see flamethrowers, caltrop throwers, sticky floors, slick floors, quicksand, bat swarms, spider webs, Deep Rock Galactic style ceiling predators, exploding chests, mimics, mines, mimes, and the inevitable death room that seals you inside and floods with water until you drown. ==================== The Conclusion: Phantom Abyss, at the time of me writing this, has only just been released as an Early Access game. Seldom to I concern myself with Early Access games, but this one brought a sense of primeval enjoyment I rarely experience. It doesn't burden its players with endless resource grinding, complicated crafting systems, flashy combos, or an arcane narrative. All you have to do is grab the whip that best suits your play style, step into the Abyss, and pray to the forgotten temple god that you have enough time for just one more run before you have to leave and be a responsible adult again.

下楼梯下到主菜单，进传送门进到主菜单，加载中加载到主菜单，这种低级BUG频繁出现，还找圣物？先逃脱主菜单吧。 OK，好不容易等到更新了，现在不闪退主菜单，直接一个报错，停止响应，直接回桌面，卧槽，接就是大公司的游戏吗？ 给想尝试的玩家推荐一下祝福： 1.鞭子加长（必备技能，最大限度的延长跳跃距离和高度，一些在天花板上的宝箱直接原地起飞就能上去，掉坑里救命之鞭，极大的提高跑图效率）搭配插翅能飞堪称最强跑图神器，谁用谁知道，推荐指数SSS级 2.插翅能飞（长按空格缓慢下落，类似于《恶魔城：晓月圆舞曲》中的飞装甲，有了就不怕摔落掉血，还能增加跳跃距离，配合二段跳加长鞭实现最大跳跃距离）推荐指数SS级 3.鞭子加速（缩短鞭子的CD时间，能更快速的收回来，这个技能在上一些连续的高的台阶很有用，尤其是有守护者追你的时候，如果勾墙失误还是有一定的机会挽救一下，搭配鞭子加长效果显著，跑图神器）推荐指数SS级 4.二段跳（增加跳跃高度，单独用它的地方不多，搭配其他技能实现效益最大化）推荐指数S 5.下蹲上跳（长按下蹲键再跳能跳得更高，有鞭子了谁还专门下蹲跳啊，有点鸡肋，但在没有鞭子加长时能弥补跳跃高度让你的鞭子带你上天花板开宝箱）推荐指数A 6.滑行空气地板（基本用不到的技能，因为只能保持几秒就下落，所以浪费钱）推荐指数B 7.守卫在下一层不会升级（一次性技能，没啥卵用，毕竟守卫的威胁不高，大多都是死于陷阱）推荐指数C 8.天外飞心（增加生命上限一颗心，且直接回复一颗心）视情况选择吧，毕竟给了你多中一次陷阱的机会 9.回复一颗心或者回复三颗心（回复三颗心出现的概率小于一颗心，回复不会超过生命上限）把钱花在这个上面属实太亏了，除非已经在冲刺最后的圣物了，否则，买技能不香吗？

[h1]第一人称神庙逃亡[/h1] [u]神庙，第一人称跑酷，多人异步， [/u] [u]支持中文，不过游戏内的文本量很小，有没有多语言支持都无关紧要。 [/u] [u]没有具体的游戏时长，玩家愿意的话可反复玩很久。而且据悉到目前为止，似乎也还没有人通关。 [/u] [u]【+有趣的智勇大闯关】[/u] 在游戏里，玩家将扮演一位被困在巨大神庙中的冒险家，需要一边躲避花样繁多的陷阱和真假难辨的机关，一边在险象环生的殿堂间寻找遗失的圣物，最终通过圣物的力量成功逃离这座神庙。整个过程简单直接，操作体验行云流水，给人一种类似智勇大闯关的感觉。加之以神庙为主题，也不难让人联想到曾经的火爆手游《神庙逃亡》。 虽然游戏的玩法十分简单（一路向跑就行了），但趣味性并不算低，在不同时间，以不同的心情去游玩该作都会得到不一样的体验。玩法趣味上，除了随机生成的各殿堂房间跟地形陷阱外，更关键的是其中的追逐环节跟异步系统（后面单独说明）。在跑酷的过程中，玩家经常会看见藏在陷阱背后的宝箱，是冒险去搜寻宝箱（搜寻宝箱可以获得金币，金币可以用来购买祝福），还是直接一股脑向前冲（节奏感会更强，抛弃了祝福也让游戏更具挑战性），由玩家决定。但不管是那一种，玩家都摆脱不了躲避守卫的抓捕。守卫分为多种不同的类型，有吐毒气炸弹的蒙面恶神，有一直追赶玩家的雷霆盛怒，还有发射热射线的苦痛之眼等。而且随着玩家闯关的深入，守卫也会逐渐得到强化，让玩家的跑酷体验变得更加的充满紧张跟刺激感（这难度不比博燃？）。 [u]【+新颖的异步系统】[/u] 第一人称跑酷游戏其实并不少，本人之前也玩过一些，不过关于异步系统的应有倒是比较少见。所谓异步，指的是在玩家游玩过程中能够看见许多陪伴在左右的幻影，这些幻影跟玩家一样，曾也是来神庙进行挑战的人，只不过最后都丧命于此。幻影记录了他们之前游玩过程的全部路径，玩家可以跟着他们的步伐前进，也能了解到他们是如何丧命的，从而让自己汲取经验教训，以便更好的发挥（话虽这样说，但是手残的玩家依旧会成为幻影并陪伴下一位前来挑战的其他冒险者）。这种体验十分特别，明明是单人游戏，却让人玩出了多人游戏的感觉。 [u]【-影响体验的严重问题】[/u] 本作在steam商店中评价是特别好评，讲真，它确实值得玩家这的一个很高的评价。不过令我没想通的是并没有看见多少人指出游戏会无缘无故跳转到主菜单页面的问题，可能并不是每个人都会遇到这种情况，但我肯定这就是一个非常严重的问题。我都记不清多少次在游玩途中被莫名其妙跳转到主菜单的界面上了，有几次还是玩到了非常靠后面的关卡进度。辛辛苦苦跑出来的成绩就被这一下子打回了原型，真的让人感觉到十分难受。虽然退出游戏可以暂时缓解这种情况的发生，但是时间久了又会出现同样的问题，着实给我带来了非常不愉快的游玩体验，希望制作组能赶紧修复！ [h1]总结及杂谈[/h1] 作为一款跑酷类游戏，本作的异步系统赋予了它独特的魅力，在多次游玩后也能感受到制作组想为这款游戏加入更多好玩的元素，后续也有很大的进步空间。期待EA后续的更新跟完善，考虑到目前存在跳转的严重问题，建议感兴趣的玩家等游戏修复后再作购买的打算。 [quote] 加入[url=https://steamcommunity.com/groups/ADZZW]爱の榨汁屋[/url]&关注[url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/34815366/]爱の鉴赏家[/url]，用爱品鉴世间作品，用心流淌真情实感。 [/quote]

[quote]关注[url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/36224058/]老实人鉴赏家 [/url] 老实人评测，不错过游戏的闪光点，不放过游戏的吐槽点，带给玩家最直观的测评感受。[/quote] 体验过《幻影深渊》这款跑酷类游戏后，打破了我刚看到游戏宣传时的的3D版神庙逃亡的初印象，实际上，除了空间中的转换外，游戏玩法设计等内容还是单纯2D跑酷无法比拟的。单从五花八门的机关陷阱来说就够玩家喝一壶了，随着游戏关卡的深入，步步紧逼的守卫者更是让玩家头疼不已。而地图的随机性，也无需担心游戏玩法的重复性，相信我，你总会在陌生又熟悉的地方死亡。 [h1]神庙、石像、多人、皮鞭？[/h1] 每进入一次游戏，都会来到随机分配的神庙中，手握长鞭的玩家虽没有飞檐走壁的特殊技能，但也能凭借长鞭的力量进行更多样化的跳跃，配合着跳跃、攀岩、滑铲等操作来探索这隐藏的财富的神庙。地图中散落着宝箱里装着金币，金币可以开启神庙中的一些快捷路径的门，也可以在石像处购买升级新的技能，这些技能更多的是辅助性的，不会让游戏有着外挂似的体验，却能加强探索神庙的能力。 游戏中的陷阱种类不算特别多，胜在组合形式多样，虽然每个陷阱地块都贴心的做成了特殊地板的样式，与普通地块进行区别，但也没那么容易躲过这一环接一环的夺命机关。好在游戏也没有那么残酷，为了增加游戏体验，初始有三颗心的生命值，像摔伤刮伤也只消耗半颗心，每深入一层会多加一颗心，死亡出局后重置。 心是给你增加了一颗，游戏难度倒是增加了不是一颗心足以比拟的。在进入第二个关卡后，神庙中会生成守卫者对你进行追击，他们并不是时时刻刻都在，而是进入特定的房间后才会生成，此时应景改变的BGM让游戏显得更惊心动魄了起来，初期不适应的时候也会手忙脚乱的慌不择路。 进行了多次游戏后，陷阱套路都摸得七七八八，神庙地形种类也差不多体验了一轮，毕竟游戏真正能体验的内容也就那么多，而进入新的关卡血量并不会刷新，所以总在前两三层徘徊的我没玩多久便开始腻了。虽然多人异步的玩法为游戏增加了一些甜头，你可以观察几个幻影玩家的行动路线来发现一些宝藏，甚至是找到他们曾经死亡的尸体，但大多时候你的关注点并不会放在他们身上。 最影响游戏体验的还要属于这个返回菜单的bug了，当你正在进入下一关时，游戏突然弹回了主界面，非常影响游戏体验，如果说是第一关卡还好，如果说是第三关卡呢，那就很玩心态了。更甚至，我玩四局游戏，其中三局都会遇到这个bug，我称之为，第一关卡体验师，主菜单徘徊者。 新颖的游戏玩法让玩家们尝到了甜头，游戏的内容却不能为游戏增加保鲜度，加上目前并不算低的定价，此刻确实不算入手游戏的好时机。如果制作组后期能为游戏增加一些新的地图，或者是新的陷阱，我想那会使游戏更加的富有吸引力。当然，如果对跑酷类型十分感兴趣的玩家，这款游戏也不会让你失望就是了。

I really love what this game is trying to do. It is a fun rogue-lite game for people who like speedrunning and parkour in games. I've seen other people say that the game doesn't really force you to go fast, but I have to disagree. You can choose to end the temple early after floor 3 and floor 6, but if you don't choose this, the game will continue to the final floor at floor 9. All this time, the temple's guardian is getting more powerful. This is what, in my opinion, keeps you moving fast. They begin firing more frequently, chasing you with more speed, or cutting off more of your routes. The only issue with guardians is that the developers need to fix their sometimes unfair placement and add more of them to the game. The guardians can basically spawn right in front of you and end your run due to no fault of your own and just RNG and that feels really bad. The progression system is pretty simple. Every time you go back to the hub, there is a new whip for purchase. The whip will have a positive effect and a negative effect. If you complete a temple of equal level of rarity of the whip, it becomes blessed and the negative effect is removed. This helps you complete more temples to get more keys to unlock more whips. Repeat! The only problem is that, in my opinion, this isn't explained well in the game and a little more explanation could be helpful. I know I'm not the only one that thought that extra whips were obtained by completing temples. In the temples, your progression is in the form of blessings. By going out of your way to open chests, you'll get coins during each run that you can spend at the end of each floor to unlock abilities that will help you on your way. As other comments have pointed out, there are a few blessings that are just ridiculous to not choose. Double jump and anything that makes your whip more easy to use are just a must. Elevation beats 90% of the traps in the game. More blessings would really help, but I think that the blessings combined with the unlockable whips leads to some fun combinations. For example, I had a whip that made me immune to fall damage and got a blessing that gave fall damage a chance to heal me. The effect: I could jump off of cliffs and never take damage and actually heal myself. It gave me a somewhat ridiculous way to keep my hearts up! I just wish more blessings were available to get these kinds of combinations going. For the phantoms... honestly, there is almost no impact. Some of the whips will give you effects based on other players phantoms such as a whip that heals you when you are near them or another whip that takes away coins when you are near them. But for the most part... I felt that this mechanic was basically just a gimmick with no real impact. If anything, having other phantoms open up chests before me was frustrating as I'd have to wait for the coins to finish coming out of a chest rather than opening it myself and continuing to run. I also think that the impact of completing a temple needs some help. As it stands, the whole "Only one person in the world will complete this temple!" is really cool, but... nobody knows you completed it except the 10 people whose loot you free and they are more likely thinking "oh neat, I get my loot bacK" and then closing the popup. I hope that a sort of temple map gets added later on that shows completed temples and how many people died trying to complete it. Some sort of way to commemorate your completion of a temple other than the relics in your hub (which give no indication of the temple you completed) would be neat and capitalize on the feeling of claiming a temple as your own. Finally, the temple generation. Personally, I both love and hate the "random" generation. I like that you can enter a room and have an idea of the layout, especially when the devouring rage is chasing you at 5 m/s lol. But, it also demystifies the game after about 5 hours of play time. You pretty much will see every room layout in that time. I think this would be okay if there were more traps in the game. I think the later levels handle this better where even if you know the room layouts, almost every square inch is trapped and you really have to watch your steps. I'd love if the whole temple was more like this! Overall, I'd say the game is worth it if you love games that focus on fluid movement and give you some adrenaline rushes when you are just about to complete a room and you hear the guardian right behind you. It's an amazingly fun concept but definitely needs some more time to fully develop. As it stands, I'm happy with my purchase and will play it all the time, but I think the average buyer could be easily disappointed with what's in the game as it is. If the trailers look like something you'd like and the reviews all saying that the temples are "samey" don't scare you away, you are going to have a really fun time.

"Once the legendary relic at the bottom of each temple is found, the temple goes away forever and becomes the priceless trophy of the skilled adventurer." This is taken straight from the store page, and based on how you like to play it may effectively be untrue. - If you want to play like EA players have up until the Adventure Update, this remains true. In which case your temple will always be a sequence of 3 floors in a biome, after which you have a choice to dip out and take a relic or keep going into the next, harder biome. - If on the contrary you want more variety in your temple, and progress the story, and climb through the ranks to get harder temple, completing temples does not close them. So much for having a unique, theme-appropriate twist for your game, huh? But ultimately, the reason I cannot recommend the game following the Adventure Update is due to the diminishing amount of meaningful player choice, and a difficulty that fails to appropriately keep up with increasing player skill. - Before the update, completing a run would bless your whip, removing the negative effect (so you would only have the beneficial effect with no downsides). After the update, you can't get rid of the negative effect, and blessing the whip merely unlocks a skin for it, that was already available through level-ups. - Before the update, losing a run would make you lose your whip, so you had to pay some in-game currency or wait for/ask a player to run the temple successfully to give it back to you. After the update, you can never lose your whip. So... pick the whip you like best and forget the others ever existed, since you can get their blessings with no downside mid-run anyway! - Since the initial release, the game has been severely lacking in passive blessings variety, and there are a handful of obviously superior choices. Once you get good enough to reliably clear temples, you can expect to be able to reproduce the same build by the end of every run, perhaps with a variance of one or two blessings. After the update, they added a different kind of shrine that lets you use a different currency to buy whip blessings (without their curse) for your run. But since this uses a separate currency that is barely used for anything else, it becomes a no-brainer to check the shrine and buy the objectively better blessing. - Before the update, the game had no means whatsoever to adapt to the rising player skill. With the adventure update, you can now play adventure mode enough to get to a rank that feels pretty good in difficulty, and then past it into the final two ranks where the game just fills each room with legions of respawning floating homing heads, and more trap density. There have been a few occasions where traps were so dense I'm not certain that damage was avoidable, especially if you factor in the guardian that's keeping the pressure on. So basically, you're better off playing the easier but consistently reasonable Classic Mode once you're done with the story. - If you're like me and tire of the overwhelmingly tedious Adventure mode, once you return to Classic Mode you'll realize the game is actually so easy that you can reliably speedrun through it without buy many/any blessings whatsoever. It's not like taking the time to buy these blessings added much run variety anyway, so why bother? This then has the domino effect of eliminating the value of gold, which has no use outside of runs, and keys, which are only used to buy whip blessings and 1 of each type to unlock the next biome (and only in Classic Mode, I believe). So you end up with a game where every run plays out the same, offers no difficulty and no incentive to play. Not something that should happen this quickly in a roguelike. - And finally, since the initial release, players have been able to purchase an infinite amount of blessings from standard shrines, provided they have enough gold to buy the next blessing. And since you have to pay before seeing the blessings, unlike the whip shrines, this creates a situation where you have no reason to check shrines you don't have gold for, and you have no reason to skip shrines you do have gold for. The most baffling thing to me is that since initial release, there is simultaneously always a shrine at the end of every floor, _and_ a shrine at the start of most floors, and sometimes even a secret chamber with a shrine inside. But these latter two are never used, because you can spend all your gold at the guaranteed one at the end of every level. To me, this is the clearest sign that the devs have not always enabled you to buy more than one blessing per shrine, and eventually reverted that and failed to adapt the game consequently. It's a sign that they don't know what's best for the game, nor do they know how to properly adapt the game to their decisions. And that is why I can't recommend this game.

[h1]3D跑酷“神庙逃亡”[/h1] 《幻影深渊》是一款大型多人异步跑酷游戏，游戏的核心玩法就是手持魔法小竹鞭，运用玩家自己高超的跑酷技巧躲避神庙之中的陷阱，并与其他玩家的幻影常伴身边进行“神庙逃亡”环节，完成神庙给出的任务，不断向下开启深渊之门，并点燃火盆，拿到神器。 游戏的跑酷玩法相当直球，玩家的目标性也非常明确，所以向着目标进发就好。游戏不用追求速度，但是追求生存是基本，是核心。在险象环生，各种陷阱之下能够完好地完成神庙任务才是游戏最根本的要求。 [h1]丰富的地形变种[/h1] 虽然游戏的核心玩法就是神庙的跑酷，而且地图的样子外观也相差不多，但是地形的变种非常多，玩家的主线任务中，多样的关卡中不同的陷阱以及不同的变种，不同的敌人攻击手段都能够相互组合成不同的地图，而玩家在每一次的神庙逃生中都能感受到完全不同的体验。不同地形的组合也让玩家每一次破关都需要使出浑身解数。此外，游戏还提供了一些冒险任务和每日任务，甚至还有吃鸡模式，丰富多样的关卡和组合让玩家时刻充满新鲜感。 [h1]全程联网状态下仿佛多人游戏[/h1] 游戏是一款大型多人在线游戏，每一次玩家的关卡开始，其实并不是孤单一个人的，而是有很多其他同样挑战关卡的玩家一起进行，而其他玩家则是以幻影的形态出现，与玩家一起游玩。但是其他玩家并非即时的，而是系统记忆了其他玩家的动作以及行驶轨迹。在玩家找不到出路的时候迷路的时候，甚至是探索宝箱找不到正确道路的时候，都可以根据其他的幻影来跟上大部队。同时，其他玩家在某些陷阱的时候也会出现死亡的状况，玩家也可以根据幻影的行为，判断自身的危险程度，并决定是否采用其他的线路和其他的方式进行。游戏中到达目的地也并非只有一种方法，往往游戏中都会提供多个线路抵达终点，甚至有些关卡还会出现金币门，需要玩家花费金币来开启一些捷径的门，从而更加容易得来到终点。 [h1]宝箱总能带给玩家惊喜[/h1] 在神庙跑酷的过程中，玩家往往可以在路途中碰到一些能够开启的宝箱，有时候会掉落一些金币，可以在神庙之中的祭坛开启一些方便玩家通关的技能，并且往往可以在多个里面选一个，还算方便。另外就是有可能会获得一些钥匙，根据玩家选择的关卡的难度不同，玩家开启宝箱获得的钥匙种类也不相同，越高等级的技能需要越高等级的钥匙。而钥匙可以在升级池中进行技能的永久升级，升级之后对玩家永久生效，在未来的关卡中能够更加方便的进行跑酷。 [h1]总结[/h1] 总体来说，游戏虽然内容并不多，但是玩起来非常有毒，丰富多样的组合让每一天玩家的跑酷经历都不尽相同，并且与朋友以及其他玩家仿佛同台竞技的感觉也非常好，是一款非常有趣的多人跑酷游戏。 [table][td][b]欢迎关注我们 [/b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/10591434/]突突突发糖辣！[/url] [/td][/table]
